lesson.title: 6.5 Don't forget your passport
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.goal: Name what you take on a trip and remind someone with Don't forget your … (Don't forget your passport! / Where's your suitcase? Here it is.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.5 A Trip to the Mall: A1 goes on a short trip by bus and taxi; A1+ 6.5 gets ready for a longer trip. The new items are passport, suitcase and backpack, the reminder Don't forget your … (2.12's Don't + a verb, now said to help someone) and the reply Here it is. to Where's your …?. The photos show each thing plainly: a passport on a table, a suitcase by the front door, Diego with a backpack, and Ana being handed her passport as she leaves with her suitcase. A1 6.11's ticket comes back.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.5 a trip; A1 6.11 ticket; A1+ 2.3 has; A1+ 2.12 Don't …; A1+ 4.1 Where's…?.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Stress PASS-port, SUIT-case, BACK-pack; link forget your (fer-GET-yer). Do not require native-like speed.
